title: The Water-Carrier and the Goldsmith's Wife
logline: On the one day a Bukhara goldsmith squeezes a customer's hand in his shop, the water-carrier who has served his house blamelessly for thirty years does exactly the same to his wife, and she is the one who works out why.
moral: What you do to others comes back to your own door: the repayment matches the deed.
tone: Quiet domestic mystery with dry comedy. Restrained and decent: the wrong is a hand held too long, shown only as two matching hand close-ups. The wife is the calm detective; the men supply the squirming.

beats.summary: A goldsmith of Bukhara and his devout wife.
The water-carrier: thirty blameless years of filling the cisterns (time-lapse and counter).
Out of nowhere he grips and squeezes her hand (hand insert no. 1) and leaves.
She is stunned; it is utterly unlike him.
She questions her husband: what did you do in your shop today?
He denies it with too many gestures; she demands the whole truth.
His confession: he squeezed a customer's hand (hand insert no. 2, the mirror of no. 1).
Strange! The carrier did the very same to me today: the two inserts side by side with an equals sign.
Why on the very day you wronged another woman? The link is made.
Shame and repentance; they pray; a sleepless night until dawn.
Next day the carrier falls on his knees before her and begs pardon.
She tells him her husband did the like; the husband admits it from the doorway.
The saying on a balance scale: the repayment matches the deed.
The wife, upright between two bowed men, faced both wrongs and brought out the truth.

Not a place: a full-panel comic insert. Flat Ben-Day field (blue for the courtyard deed, yellow for the remembered shop deed) with an inner border 14 thick in the colour code of the man (brown or green). Holds one handClasp drawing at about 700 px wide.

Flat paper card filling the panel (paper colour, blue dot fade in the corners, scroll curl along the top) for the balance scale and the saying. Reuse the style box and title primitives; no perspective.

props.description: Planned prop waterskin (AN-083): goatskin bag about 150 x 90, brown with dark dot shading, tied neck, shoulder strap; fields fill 0..1 (bulge), slosh, tilt, squeeze. Worn on the back (drawn behind the person, strap across the chest) or held at the neck with both hands to pour.

Stone water trough 170 wide x 100 high (rim y 800 when on ground 900), grey with blue dot shadow, rim 14 thick; field level 0..1 draws the blue water surface line inside the rim and spill drops above 1. Two of them in the courtyard.
Gold bangle: yellow ring outer r 26, inner r 18, black outline, three red gem dots, a white glint arc; drawn flat on the anvil, held in a hand, and as an ellipse (26 x 10) round a wrist.

The picture the film turns on, built on the planned ladyHand (AN-109). Two large hands in profile on a flat field: hand B (the woman, vertical, sleeve from one side) and hand A (the man, horizontal, sleeve from the other side) wrapping it. See new_assets for dimensions and fields.
Flat balance scale: post 300 tall, beam 560 x 12 pivoting at the top (tilt in radians), two chains 150 long, pans 200 x 24 (shallow arcs) that stay level; yellow with black outline.
Planned prop (AN-075): loop of 11 small beads (r 5) with a tassel, hung from one hand; one bead advances per 0.5 s.
Small coin purse: yellow circle r 14 with a tied neck on a 40 long string.

subtitles.ar: في مدينة بخارى عاش صائغ ذهب مع زوجته المعروفة بالتقوى وحسن السيرة.|وكان سقاء يحمل الماء إلى بيتهما منذ ثلاثين عامًا،|يدخل الفناء ويملأ الأحواض،|ثم ينصرف دون أن يزعج أحدًا.
subtitles.en: In Bukhara a goldsmith lived with his devout wife.|A water-carrier had brought water to their home for thirty years,|filling the cisterns|and leaving without trouble.

subtitles.ar: ذات يوم جاءت الزوجة إلى فناء البيت بينما كان السقاء يفرغ الماء.|اقترب منها فجأة، وأمسك يدها وضغط عليها،|ثم خرج. دهشت المرأة،|فقد كان يتصرف دائمًا بأدب واحترام.
subtitles.en: One day the wife stood in the courtyard while the water-carrier worked.|Suddenly he gripped and squeezed her hand,|then left. She was shocked|by this unfamiliar behavior.

subtitles.ar: عاد الصائغ من السوق، فسألته زوجته بجدية:|ماذا فعلت اليوم في دكانك؟ هل ارتكبت أمرًا خطأ؟|أجاب أنه لم يفعل شيئًا،|لكنها أصرت أن يقول لها الحقيقة كاملة.
subtitles.en: When the goldsmith returned,|she asked whether he had done anything wrong in his shop.|He denied it,|but she insisted on the full truth.

subtitles.ar: اعترف الزوج بأن امرأة طلبت منه صنع سوار ذهبي.|وعندما عادت ليلبسها السوار، أعجبه جمال معصمها،|فأمسك يدها وضغط عليها بغير حق،|ثم تركها تنصرف.
subtitles.en: He admitted making a gold bracelet for a customer.|When she returned to try it on, he admired her wrist|and improperly pressed and squeezed her hand,|then let her leave.

subtitles.ar: قالت الزوجة: عجيب!|لقد أمسك السقاء يدي اليوم بالطريقة نفسها.|طوال ثلاثين عامًا لم يفعل شيئًا كهذا.|لماذا وقع هذا في يوم أخطأت فيه أنت مع امرأة أخرى؟
subtitles.en: His wife replied|that the water-carrier had done precisely the same to her that day,|though he had never behaved that way|in thirty years.

subtitles.ar: شعر الصائغ بالخجل،|وطلب من زوجته أن تدعو له بالمغفرة، وأعلن ندمه على ما فعل.|ودعت هي أيضًا أن يغفر الله لهما،|لكن الحادثة بقيت تشغلهما حتى جاء الصباح.
subtitles.en: Ashamed,|the goldsmith repented and asked his wife to pray for forgiveness.|She prayed for them both,|though the incident still troubled them.

subtitles.ar: في اليوم التالي عاد السقاء،|وما إن رأى المرأة حتى جثا أمامها وطلب العفو.|قال: غرني الشيطان ففعلت ما لا يليق.|فأجابته أن زوجها قد ارتكب في متجره فعلًا مشابهًا.
subtitles.en: The next day|the water-carrier knelt before her and begged pardon,|blaming temptation.|She told him her husband had committed a similar act in his shop.

subtitles.ar: انتهت الحكاية بقول صار يتناقله الناس:|الجزاء من جنس العمل، والضربة تقابلها ضربة.|هكذا ربط الراوي بين التصرفين،|بينما بقيت المرأة هي التي واجهت الخطأين وكشفت الحقيقة.
subtitles.en: The tale ends with a saying|that one act is repaid by a like act.|Its narrator linked the offenses,|while the wife confronted the wrongdoing and exposed the truth.

new_assets.name: handClasp
new_assets.description: Close-up of a man's hand gripping a woman's hand, parameterised by sleeve colours; reuses the planned ladyHand for hand B. Used full panel (S5, S10), as inset panels at scale 0.42 (S12, S13, S19, S20), tiny in a thought cloud (S15) and as a balloon icon (S17, S18).
new_assets.implementation: handClasp(ctx, x, y, {s, grip, squeeze, splay, palA, palB, bracelet, flip}). At s 1 about 700 x 420. Hand B: ladyHand shape (palm rounded box 150 x 190, four finger capsules 34 wide, thumb), skin colour with red dot shading, sleeve cuff 170 x 120 in palB with dots, optional gold bracelet ellipse at the wrist. Hand A: palm box 200 x 150 coming in horizontally, sleeve in palA; grip 0..1 moves it from 260 px away to contact and curls four finger capsules round the back of hand B (draw order: A thumb, B, A fingers). squeeze 0..1 narrows hand B by 8 %, adds 3 white knuckle arcs on A and three red pressure lines each side. splay 0..1 fans hand B fingers by 0.25 rad. flip mirrors in x. All fields keyed by t, no state.

new_assets.name: courtyardHouse
new_assets.description: The planned town house courtyard (AN-114), used here without the fountain and with two cisterns and a bench; street door left, house door right, three arches.
new_assets.implementation: Bake the static wall, arches and paving once with bake(); townDoor for both doors (live), skyCycle behind the wall top, townArchPts for the arches. Return anchors {ground, streetDoor, houseDoor, arches, bench {sitY}, cisterns [x]}. Dimensions in sets.courtyard.

new_assets.name: waterskin
new_assets.description: Planned goatskin bag (AN-083) with fill, slosh, tilt, squeeze; plus a pour arc helper (blue bezier strip from the neck to a target with 3 drops).
new_assets.implementation: Body = closed bezier blob whose lower bulge scales with fill; neck = small rectangle with a tie; strap = two lines to the shoulder. pourArc(ctx, from, to, t) = quadratic strip 10 wide in blue with white highlight, drops by K.rng seeded on the scene.

new_assets.name: cistern
new_assets.description: Stone trough with a water level field and spill; reusable as any trough, basin or well head.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded box 170 x 100 with rim; water = blue rect clipped inside the rim to height level * 70; ripple() on fill; spill = 3 drops over the rim when level > 1.

new_assets.name: balanceScale
new_assets.description: Flat balance scale with tilt and level pans, for morals about justice and repayment.
new_assets.implementation: Post rect, beam rotated by tilt about the pivot, pans hung at the beam ends (position from the rotation, pans not rotated); tilt driven by swing() after each drop.

new_assets.name: bracelet
new_assets.description: Small gold bangle with red gems, flat and on-wrist views.
new_assets.implementation: Two circles (ring) or an ellipse arc pair front/back of the wrist; gem dots; glint arc.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon icons (imp, stall, clasp, scale)
new_assets.description: Four small flat icons for the planned iconBalloon: a red horned imp head, a stall awning, the clasp in two colourways (a reduced handClasp), a tiny scale.
new_assets.implementation: Each icon is a function (ctx, x, y, s) of 5 to 10 flat shapes; the clasp icon calls handClasp at s 0.12 with grip 1.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English of paragraph 5 omits the Arabic closing question ("Why did this happen on a day when you wronged another woman?"); both are kept verbatim, and the staging (S13) follows the Arabic.

SCRIPT: the English of paragraph 1 has no equivalent of "known for piety and good conduct" beyond "devout", and paragraph 2 drops "he had always behaved with courtesy and respect"; both kept verbatim.
The improper touch is shown only as a stylised close-up of two hands (no faces, under 3.5 s each time) so the film stays decent for all ages; default: yes, hand inserts only.

Invented comic lettering: BUKHARA, THE GOLDSMITH, HIS WIFE, THE WATER-CARRIER, FULL, ONE DAY..., SQUEEZE!, WRONG?, THE TRUTH!, GOLD, WRONG!, STRANGE!, 0 TIMES, WHY?, SAME DAY, NEXT DAY..., ONE DEED, ONE ANSWER; default: keep all.
The saying is paraphrased on screen as WHAT YOU DO... / ...IS DONE TO YOU (the subtitle carries the script wording); default: keep this paraphrase.
"Satan deceived me" is pictured as a tiny red horned imp icon whispering in a picture balloon (2 s); default: keep the imp icon rather than leave the line unpictured.
Additions beyond the script: the goldsmith peeks from the house door and admits it during the wife's answer (143.9), and both men stand bowed beside her in the final picture; default: keep both.
Prayer is shown as raised open palms with a soft light cone, with no text or religious symbols on screen; default: yes.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; set LIFE.t = t every frame so all four people blink; override with explicit lid/noBlink where the plan says "no blink".

Colour code is structural: goldsmith GREEN, carrier BROWN, wife BLUE sleeve, customer RED sleeve. The inset borders, the handClasp sleeves and the balloon icons must use exactly these four colours so the match reads without words.

S5 and S10 must share timing and geometry (grip at +0.24 s, squeeze at +1.5 s, same pressure lines); S10 is S5 with flip:true and other palettes. Build one function clasp(t0, pal) and call it for both, for the insets, the cloud and the icons.

The person figure is front facing: stage every meeting as a two-shot with dir set toward the partner and use handLW/handRW world targets for the tray, purse, bracelet and waterskin neck. In S4 the actual touch happens in the insert, so the wide shot only needs his reaching arm (PERSON_HANDS.reach) entering her space.
Carrier age is keyed (kfn 13.5 to 15.2: 0.2 to 0.7) and stays 0.7 afterwards, including inside the S6 thought cloud.

Bare-headed goldsmith (107.3 on, S18, S20): if the costume layer cannot hide headwear, draw him with pal hc matching the hair colour and a flat cap shape, or add an opt-in field; the held turban is a separate small drawing (yellow dome 90 x 60 with dots and the pin). Do not change the merchant preset default.
Thought clouds: S6 420 x 300 at scale 0.6; S9 and S11 860 x 640 at scale 0.75 (figures about 180 px); S15 300 x 170 holding two clasp icons. Keep every cloud clear of the faces below it.
Camera: clamp as in the template camAt; apply shake inside the panel clip only. The NEXT DAY card at 125.9 hides the cut from the room to the courtyard at its covered midpoint.

Sound: 12 quiet effects, all inside listed pauses (8.5 chime, 22.75 pop, 44.45 whoosh, 47.75 thud, 56.6 pop, 64.7 thud, 71.45 and 71.9 chime as hammer tinks, 78.0 whoosh, 88.95 pop, 105.2 thud) plus the 170.3 chime after the last word. No effect on either squeeze: the narration covers both.

Word cues: use w(p, n) from timing.json; every action cue in creative_plan.json names the Arabic word and its start time. The word هي at about 117.6 is interpolated, so key S15 from أيضًا (117.60) instead.
Subtitles: four chunks per paragraph as marked in subtitles; rebuild chunk text from the script words so it stays verbatim.
warnings: New drawing load is on the high side: handClasp (M) and courtyardHouse (M) plus four small props. handClasp must be drawn large and clean; it is on screen in seven scenes. Review it alone on a still before staging.

The hands of the Library person are small discs; the story is about a hand. All readable hand acting therefore lives in the inserts and insets, and the wide shots must not try to show the grip itself.
Narration has few pauses after 105.8 s, so the last third has no sound effects except the end chime; rely on picture changes there.
S9 packs the whole shop flashback into 13 s inside a cloud; keep the cloud figures at 180 px or more and cut the bracelet-making to one hammer pose if it feels crowded.
courtyardHouse is planned by AN-114 with a fountain; coordinate so one set serves both (fountain optional, cisterns and bench as props).
